title: Proposals
description: TC39 proposals across all supported specifications and process stages.

ProposalStage.title: Proposal stage
ProposalStage.description: A stage of the TC39 process.

Specification.title: Specification
Specification.description: An ECMA specification targeted by a proposal.

DelegateReference.title: Delegate reference
DelegateReference.description: A TC39 delegate, identified by an abbreviation in @tc39/data-delegates.

CommunityMember.title: Community member
CommunityMember.description: A proposal contributor who is not referenced as a TC39 delegate.

github.description: The contributor's GitHub username, if known.

Person.title: Person
Person.description: An author, champion, or reviewer of a proposal.

Presentation.title: Presentation
Presentation.description: A presentation of a proposal to the committee.

date.description: The meeting month as YYYY-MM, or its date as YYYY-MM-DD when a day is recorded.

notesUrl.description: A link to the meeting notes for this presentation, if known.

Test262Coverage.title: Test262 coverage
Test262Coverage.description: Test262 coverage recorded for a Stage 2.7 or Stage 3 proposal.

hasTests.description: Whether the proposal has Test262 tests or a feature flag.

url.description: A link to the proposal's Test262 tests, search results, pull request, or tracking issue.

featureFlag.description: The Test262 feature flag or other coverage label, if known.

url.description: The proposal's canonical HTTPS URL, or an empty string for a proposal without a repository.

stage27Reviewers.description: The delegates and community members reviewing the proposal for Stage 2.7.

expectedPublicationYear.description: The expected or actual year of publication in an ECMAScript standard.

rationale.description: Why a proposal has a terminal status.
